title: RRDS Signed Version Append / File Creation Request v1
description: EIP-712 signed version-registration payload submitted to POST /v1/files (version 1) and POST /v1/files/{fileId}/versions (version N > 1) after encrypted content and envelope-set objects satisfy the configured IPFS Cluster pin quorum.

displayName.description: Required only for initial file creation (versionNumber = 1); visible consortium metadata.

parentFolderId.description: Required only for initial file creation (versionNumber = 1); all-zero for root folder.

parentManifestHash.description: All-zero for version 1; must equal currentHeadManifestHash for version N > 1.

manifestHash.description: SHA-256 digest of the canonical encrypted-file-manifest-v1 JSON.

contentCid.description: Canonical lower-case base32 CIDv1 of the pinned encrypted content package.

envelopeSetCid.description: Canonical lower-case base32 CIDv1 of the pinned canonical key-envelope-set-v1 object.

signature.description: 65-byte low-s secp256k1 EIP-712 signature (r || s || v) over VersionAppend under the RRDS FileRegistry domain.
